params.title: Fact check
params.body: Physics + Maths ka raasta NIOS se bhi hai

claims.claim: CPL needs Class 12 with Physics and Maths, a DGCA Class 2 medical first and a Class 1 medical for the CPL, DGCA theory exams and RTR(A), and at least 200 hours of flying.
Under the current rules arts and commerce students qualify by clearing Physics and Maths through open schooling (NIOS); DGCA's proposal to drop the requirement was still pending as of October 2026.
